nerfed.condition.left_arm.name: Left arm disabled
nerfed.condition.left_arm.desc: The use of the left arm has been lost.
nerfed.condition.left_arm.effect: The left hand can't hold or use items.
nerfed.condition.right_arm.name: Right arm disabled
nerfed.condition.right_arm.desc: The use of the right arm has been lost.
nerfed.condition.right_arm.effect: The right hand can't hold or use items.
nerfed.condition.left_leg.name: Left leg disabled
nerfed.condition.left_leg.desc: The use of the left leg has been lost.
nerfed.condition.left_leg.effect: Walking is replaced by hopping. With both legs disabled, you crawl instead.
nerfed.condition.right_leg.name: Right leg disabled
nerfed.condition.right_leg.desc: The use of the right leg has been lost.
nerfed.condition.right_leg.effect: Walking is replaced by hopping. With both legs disabled, you crawl instead.
nerfed.condition.tunnel_vision.name: Tunnel vision
nerfed.condition.tunnel_vision.desc: Peripheral vision is lost, leaving only a narrow central view.
nerfed.condition.tunnel_vision.effect: The edges of the screen are dark.
nerfed.condition.myopia.name: Myopia
nerfed.condition.myopia.desc: Short-sightedness: things look blurred without correction.
nerfed.condition.night_blindness.name: Night blindness
nerfed.condition.night_blindness.desc: Difficulty seeing in low light. Dim places become very dark, while well-lit areas stay clear.
nerfed.condition.night_blindness.effect: Dark areas fade to black. Torches and daylight help.
nerfed.condition.light_sensitivity.name: Light sensitivity
nerfed.condition.light_sensitivity.desc: Bright light is uncomfortable and overwhelming. Glare spreads and bright surfaces wash out.
nerfed.condition.light_sensitivity.effec: Bright areas glow and wash out.
nerfed.condition.double_vision.name: Double vision
nerfed.condition.double_vision.desc: Each thing is seen twice, as two overlapping images slightly apart.
nerfed.condition.double_vision.effect: A second, offset image drifts over the screen.
nerfed.condition.blindness.name: Blindness
nerfed.condition.blindness.desc: Little or no sight. Footsteps and taps send out vibrations that briefly reveal what is around you.
nerfed.condition.blindness.effect: The world is dark. Vibrations outline nearby surfaces.
nerfed.condition.colourblind_protan.name: Protanopia
nerfed.condition.colourblind_protan.desc: A form of red-green colourblindness. Reds look darker and are hard to tell from greens.
nerfed.condition.colourblind_protan.effe: A colour filter is applied to the screen.
nerfed.condition.colourblind_deuteran.de: A form of red-green colourblindness. Greens and reds are hard to tell apart.
nerfed.condition.colourblind_deuteran.ef: A colour filter is applied to the screen.
nerfed.condition.colourblind_tritan.name: Tritanopia
nerfed.condition.colourblind_tritan.desc: A rare form of colourblindness where blues and yellows are hard to tell apart.
nerfed.condition.colourblind_tritan.effe: A colour filter is applied to the screen.
nerfed.condition.colourblind_mono.name: Monochromacy
nerfed.condition.colourblind_mono.desc: Colour cannot be seen at all, only shades of grey.
nerfed.condition.colourblind_mono.effect: The screen is shown in greyscale.
nerfed.condition.deafness.name: Deafness
nerfed.condition.deafness.desc: Hearing loss: sounds are quieter, muffled and harder to make out.
nerfed.condition.deafness.effect: All sounds are quieter and muffled.
nerfed.condition.mute.name: Mute
nerfed.condition.mute.desc: Unable to speak. Messages can't be sent in chat.
nerfed.condition.mute.effect: Chat and messaging commands are blocked.
nerfed.condition.tremors.name: Tremors
nerfed.condition.tremors.desc: Involuntary shaking, most noticeable in the hands.
nerfed.condition.adhd.name: ADHD
nerfed.condition.adhd.desc: Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder affects focus, impulse control and energy levels.
nerfed.condition.vertigo.name: Vertigo
nerfed.condition.vertigo.desc: A sense of spinning or lost balance, often brought on by heights or movement.
nerfed.condition.prosopagnosia.name: Prosopagnosia
nerfed.condition.prosopagnosia.desc: Also called face blindness: difficulty recognising people by their faces.
nerfed.condition.schizophrenia.name: Schizophrenia
nerfed.condition.schizophrenia.desc: A long-term condition that can affect thinking, perception and emotions. Experiences vary widely from person to person.
nerfed.condition.scoliosis.name: Scoliosis
nerfed.condition.scoliosis.desc: A sideways curve of the spine, which can affect posture and comfort.
